mapper.select: SELECT br.*, t.name as teacher_name, b.title as book_title, b.isbn, l.position_code as location_code, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), br.due_date) as overdue_days FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN teacher t ON br.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN stock s ON br.stock_id = s.id LEFT JOIN location l ON s.location_id = l.id WHERE br.id = #{id}

SELECT br.*, t.name as teacher_name, b.title as book_title, b.author as author, b.isbn, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), br.due_date) as overdue_days FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN teacher t ON br.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id ORDER BY br.borrow_date DESC

SELECT br.*, t.name as teacher_name, t.email, t.phone, b.title as book_title, b.author as author, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), br.due_date) as overdue_days FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN teacher t ON br.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE (br.status = 1 OR br.status = 3) AND br.due_date < CURDATE() AND br.return_date IS NULL

SELECT br.*, t.name as teacher_name, b.title as book_title, b.author as author, b.isbn, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), br.due_date) as overdue_days FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN teacher t ON br.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE br.status = 1 AND br.due_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY br.due_date ASC
